40/G.goal: Describe how navigation and system-control interaction are designed in an immersive XR experience.
40/G.achieves: It supports the course aim of building an XR system with confidence by giving the learner a design-level understanding of core movement and control functions.

40/O1.goal: Explain how navigation in an immersive XR experience is composed of travel and wayfinding, including the main locomotion techniques and wayfinding supports that enable it.
40/O1.achieves: It gives the learner a framework for analyzing the travel and wayfinding choices that shape an immersive system's user experience.

40/O2.goal: Describe the interaction techniques used to issue commands and change the state or mode of an XR system.
40/O2.achieves: It lets the learner specify how users will control the system, connecting navigation design to overall system-control design.
